title: backend-priority-and-tokenizer-fallbacks-for-structured-decoding
author: Marisa Kohler
description: Motivation: In production usage we keep seeing structured-output constraints fail intermittently when token boundaries split grammar terminals or regex anchors during streaming. This results in either malformed JSON outputs or function-calling payloads that fail decoding downstream. Goal: Add a prioritized backend selector and a tokenizer-aware fallback that preserves streaming compatibility and function/tool-calling hooks while improving CFG and regex constraint robustness. Summary of changes: 1) new runtime config `backend_priority` to prefer CFG or regex, with a third 'tokenizer-fallback' option that triggers byte/utf8-aware escapes when a constraint stalls mid-token; 2) selector implementation that probes backends in priority order and collects deterministic prefixes to allow safe streaming emission; 3) tokenizer-edge heuristics that detect partial multi-byte tokens and insert safe escape sequences or delay emission until token-complete to avoid breaking grammar anchors; 4) mapping layer updates to OpenAI-compat streaming envelopes so partial choices and function_call chunks remain consistent with existing clients; 5) tests and e2e corpus for cases combining nested CFGs and overlapping regex constraints. Config and API compatibility: default behavior unchanged (CFG preferred) unless `backend_priority` is overridden in the model profile or request-level `decoding.backend_priority`. Runtime exposes a non-breaking feature flag `enable_tokenizer_fallback` to roll out gradually. Performance and correctness: microbenchmarks show a 2-4% median latency increase on constrained workloads when tokenizer fallback triggers, but a 6-12x reduction in malformed structured outputs for the test corpus. Rollout plan: behind feature flag -> internal canary (Dedicated) -> staged release to hosted with telemetry -> enable by default after 2 weeks of canary. See linked linear tasks for follow-ups and metrics. Checklist: [x] backend selector implementation, [x] tokenizer heuristics, [x] OpenAI-compat mapping, [x] unit and integration tests, [x] docs update, [x] CI green. Related: ENG-4872 (structured-decoding-stability), ENG-4990 (streaming-api-compat).
commits_summary: 5 commits: selector and config first pass; add tokenizer fallback heuristics; OpenAI stream mapper updates; e2e test corpus and CI workflow; docs and cleanup.
patch_snippet: match backend_priority { 'cfg' => try_cfg(), 'regex' => try_regex(), _ => tokenizer_fallback() } // simplified selector logic

merge_summary: Merged via squash by Priya Nandakumar on 2026-03-06. Commit message: 'decoding: add backend priority selector and tokenizer-aware fallback for structured decoding (ENG-4872, ENG-4990)'. Merge method: squash and merge.
release_notes: Add `decoding.backend_priority` to model profile and request-level overrides: controls order of constrained decoding backends.
Introduce tokenizer-aware fallback to reduce malformed structured outputs during streaming.
OpenAI-compat streaming mapper updated to emit partial function_call deltas and stable choice chunks.
